issue_context.title: Growatt Server: 1 plant, multiple inverters
issue_context.body:
### The problem

I've used the Growatt Server integration for some time with 1 inverter and had no problems.

Recently I've added a second inverter to the same plant, but am unable to get a sensor for the second inverter in Home Assistant. 
Everything on server.growatt.com is working correctly, and when I do a direct API call (using https://github.com/indykoning/PyPi_GrowattServer), both inverters also show up.

I've tried removing the integration completely.
Results:
- Total energy production, total output power is shown correctly (sum of both inverters)
- First invert correctly gets its own sensor with all data correct.
- Second inverter does not show up at all.

Inverter details:
Inverter 1: (old): MTL type (growatt API device type 'inverter')
Invert 2: (newly installed): MIN type (growatt API device type 'tlx')

Could it be that the mixing of these two types of inverters is causing this problem?

### What is version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

Home Assistant 2021.6.0

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant OS

### Integration causing the issue

Growatt Server

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/growatt_server/

### Example YAML snippet

_No response_

### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us?

_No response_

### Additional information

_No response_
comments:
Hey there @indykoning, @muppet3000, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with an integration (`growatt_server`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L193) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>
Hi, i am afraid this is because we don't have support for TLX devices quite yet. Once #38908 is fixed and merged there will be support for it 😄

Thanks for the reply. Hopefully this can be merged soon. As a temporary workaround I just added a command_line sensor that directly calls the Growatt API to get the specific data I need from this inverter. Hacky, but it works for now.. :) 

Edit: 
figured it makes sense if somebody else finds this from Google to include the temporary workaround.
Note: this is a dirty hack and not recommended!

-Must have the Growatt Server integration installed (for dependency on growattServer)
-Add a command line sensor in config.yaml: 

```
  - platform: command_line
    name: MyHackySensor
    command: python3 -c "import growattServer;api = growattServer.GrowattApi();loginResponse = api.login('USERNAME','PASSWORD');print(api.tlx_detail('INVERTERID')['data']['PARAMETERYOUNEED'])"
    unit_of_measurement: "W"

```
Parameters of interest (only for TLX inverters, that includes the MIN/MIC types):
'pac'  Generated PV power, AC side
'ppv1' Generated PV power String 1
'vpv1' String voltage String 1
etc.

To find out what other data you can get from the inverter:
https://pypi.org/project/growattServer/
